notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Snap, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand, and untapping two lands you control.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping two lands you control.
Repeat.
You may instead bounce any creature you don't control to its owner's hand instead of bouncing the generic creature, as long as your opponents control creatures.
